name: TrustDemoIND04
title: TD.IND.04 Imported doses carrying a national schedule code
description: Of the foreign doses imported as verified, the proportion that carry a national schedule code beside the issuer's code, and so count toward the schedule.
guidance: A definition only: it states no target and no value. Data elements: TD.J3B.DE01 Issuer's product code; TD.J3B.DE02 National schedule code; TD.J3B.DE03 Mapping basis; TD.J3B.DE05 Counts toward the schedule. Decision tables: TD.DT.02, TD.DT.03. Requirements: STD-SEM-001, STD-SCH-001. The populations are described, not computable: this guide carries no CQL.

population.description: Doses imported as verified in the reporting period.

criteria.expression: COUNT of imported doses (TD.J3B) WHERE imported in the reporting period AND "Mapping basis" != not-imported

population.description: Doses imported as verified in the reporting period that carry a national schedule code.

criteria.expression: COUNT of imported doses (TD.J3B) WHERE imported in the reporting period AND "Mapping basis" in (concept-map, clinician-confirmed)
